title: Maximize Sum Of Array After K Negations
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, perform exactly k negations by changing the sign of any element at an index.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, perform exactly k negations by changing the sign of any element at an index. The task is to find the maximum possible sum of the array after these negations.
constraints: Perform exactly k operations, each negating one chosen element; an index may be reused.
hints: Flip negative values from most negative upward; each such flip gives the largest immediate gain.
After useful negative flips, only parity matters because two flips cancel.
If one odd flip remains, negate the smallest absolute current value.
Exchange arguments maximize every beneficial gain and minimize the only unavoidable loss.
editorial: Exchange arguments maximize every beneficial gain and minimize the only unavoidable loss.

tests.explanation: Negating two gives the maximum sum five.
Flip -1 once and use remaining flips on zero, yielding sum six.
